instruction: Studio photograph, medium close-up at eye-level. In an indoor setting with white vertical wood-paneled walls, a woman in a denim shirt (R2) stands behind a man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1). The woman (R2) tightly clasps her arms around the midsection of the man (R1) from behind to perform abdominal thrusts. Both wear white medical gloves. The man (R1) tilts his head back with his eyes closed in distress, while the woman (R2) maintains a serious, focused expression. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene with soft shadows.
